outcome: No renderer change ships. All 520 complete definitions and generated artifacts are restored exactly. The optional native ImageBitmap cache preserves tested pixels and resource ownership, but sequential CPU4 measurements do not establish a benefit. Keep the original Canvas2D renderer and its unresolved timing gate.
scope: Renderer investigation and reusable comparison tooling. No whole-handoff, final frame-rate, all-component startup or manual accessibility acceptance claim.

preservation.inputMethod: Each production file retains the exact local byte hash captured earlier in this phase. Separately, versioned content matches HEAD with only Windows CRLF/LF normalized for that Git comparison. Frozen files are never rewritten.

tooling.reference: --reference=file compares one JS-only candidate against the current production fields and hashes that reference. --require-snapshots requires actual bitmap creation and drawing in every native candidate story.
tooling.clock: Pending snapshot jobs settle between source frames without advancing the virtual clock. Disposal checks every created snapshot is closed. The production renderer has no bitmap cache; optional instrumentation does not require one unless requested.
tooling.URL: The shared helper selects the actual HTTP argument instead of treating a reference flag as a URL. The first invalid-URL run remains archived.
tooling.comparisonBounds: The unchanged original source factory, complete source/clock/command state, every one of 1,776 native columns, padded source neighborhoods, exact RGBA bytes and existing1e-9 geometry bounds remain required.

isolatedCandidatePainter.scope: Actual source images and native painter with a fake model API, separate from complete controller stories.

timing.qualification: Own Showcase verification and all other own heavy checks had finished before the ABBA run. Other host work was not controlled; before/after CPU samples are observations, not an isolation guarantee. Both current desktop samples are slower than both before desktop samples; compact samples vary. This does not establish an intrinsic universal regression or a reliable gain, and it does not pass 60fps at CPU4.
timing.initialPrototype: The first bitmap-only trial looked faster than an earlier baseline. It is retained as a separate prototype, not substituted for the later owned-cache ABBA comparison.

rejectedExperiments.assessment: Cached local paths, cached exact math and desynchronized contexts preserve sampled pixels but do not establish a timing gain. Vertical clips, software rasterization and whole-image source draws fail literal pixel comparisons. No tolerance is introduced. The owned bitmap cache passes its correctness stories but remains unshipped for lack of a demonstrated timing benefit.
rejectedExperiments.cpuSampling: The separate CPU profiler is diagnostic and preserves its first failed dependency-resolution attempt. It does not certify frame rate.
